description: Interactive step-based calculation practice tool for Grade 7 Mathematics — Direct HCF Method with Minimum Occurrences. Walks students through finding HCF using prime factorisations with progressive reveal, comparison table, coloured prime blocks, pencil box analogy, and verification. Singularity Design System with Poppins font.

toolCallExamples.title: Example 1: Default textbook — HCF(225, 750)
toolCallExamples.description: Step-based walkthrough of HCF(225,750) from Chapter 3 Example 5
toolCallExamples.teaching_notes: Step 1: Present numbers. Step 2: Show factorisations. Step 3: Identify common primes (2 is NOT common). Steps 4-5: Count each common prime and take minimum. Step 6: Multiply. Step 7: Verify.
toolCallExamples.instructions_for_student: Follow the direct HCF method step by step. For each common prime, take the minimum count. Multiply to get the HCF.

toolCallExamples.title: Example 2: Easy warm-up — HCF(12, 16)
toolCallExamples.description: Simpler numbers for introducing the method
toolCallExamples.instructions_for_student: Start with these small numbers to understand the method before trying harder ones.

toolCallExamples.title: Example 3: HCF(30, 72) from textbook Example 4
toolCallExamples.instructions_for_student: 30 = 2 × 3 × 5, 72 = 2³ × 3². Common primes are 2 and 3. Take minimum of each.

toolCallExamples.title: Example 4: Co-prime detection — HCF(96, 275)
toolCallExamples.instructions_for_student: When numbers share NO common primes, the HCF is 1. These are co-prime numbers.

toolCallExamples.title: Example 5: Factor-multiple — HCF(81, 243)
toolCallExamples.instructions_for_student: When one number divides the other exactly, the HCF equals the smaller number.

toolCallExamples.title: Example 6: Advanced — HCF(400, 2500)
toolCallExamples.description: Larger numbers from Figure it Out exercises
toolCallExamples.instructions_for_student: The method works the same way with larger numbers. Stay systematic!

toolCallExamples.title: Example 7: Compact mode without analogy
toolCallExamples.description: Hide pencil box for focused mathematical view
toolCallExamples.instructions_for_student: Find HCF(45, 75) using the direct method.

toolCallExamples.title: Example 8: Auto-play presentation mode
toolCallExamples.description: Teacher can project and let it auto-advance
toolCallExamples.instructions_for_student: Watch the steps unfold automatically and follow along!
